infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SwiftGuard uses your location to provide security services, dispatch guards to your location, and enable emergency response features.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: SwiftGuard uses your location to provide security services, dispatch guards to your location, and enable emergency response features. Background location is used for shift tracking and emergency services.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: SwiftGuard uses background location for shift tracking and emergency services. This ensures we can provide security services even when the app is not actively in use.
infoPlist.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: SwiftGuard does not track users across other apps or websites for advertising purposes.
